overall_status: UNTESTED: the four-case VarnodeBank key-lifecycle projection (both tree iteration orders with class/createIndex/SeqNum-order projections, per-Varnode membership counts, insert/input/written/free flags, defining SeqNum order after each rebinding) byte-matches the locked oracle through the production Funcdata::opSetOutput/opUnsetOutput closure, including the hand-built in-place key-drift topology that previously panicked Rugra's key-recomputed makeFree erase; residuals are limited to the unobservable ownership guard for foreign handles (Ghidra counterpart is construction-only), the union-resolution arm of ActionSetCasts::castOutput itself, and makeFree on an input-class Varnode, none of which the castOutput closure reaches

oracle.signature: void VarnodeBank::makeFree(Varnode *vn); Varnode *VarnodeBank::setInput(Varnode *vn); Varnode *VarnodeBank::setDef(Varnode *vn,PcodeOp *op); void Funcdata::opSetOutput(PcodeOp *op,Varnode *newvn); void Funcdata::opUnsetOutput(PcodeOp *op)

architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the production Funcdata::opSetOutput / opUnsetOutput / opDestroy chain on synthetic def-use graphs (newOp/opSetInput/opSetOutput/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/newConstant/newVarnode/setInputVarnode) plus one hand-built in-place def wiring (PcodeOp::setOutput + Varnode::setDirect) that bypasses VarnodeBank::setDef's erase-reinsert; no Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata with one basic block; ops receive BlockBasic::insert midpoint SeqNum orders via opInsertEnd; constants are single-use so the opSetInput constant dedup never fires; all named Varnodes live in the register space at distinct offsets (0x80-0x180) with const-space constants sorting first
analysis_options.observation: Per stage: the complete location-tree iteration order (name.space.hexoffset.size.class.createIndex) and definition-tree iteration order (name.class.seqorder-or-dash.space.hexoffset.size.createIndex), per-Varnode membership counts in both trees, free/insert/input/written flags, and the defining SeqNum order; case makefree_inplace_key_drift observes the tree before the drift, while the live key is drifted (physical node positions unchanged), and after makeFree restored
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, membership, or position normalization; both sides print the same projection of the same observation fields; SeqNum orders print the raw getOrder() value

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: opsetoutput_swap: castOutput-semantics output rebinding; opSetOutput(B,out1) with out1 written by A follows opUnsetOutput(A)->makeFree->setDef(out1,B), then the symmetric swap back to A; two full free/written key-class crossings with stable iteration orders and single membership in both trees at every stage

makefree_inplace_key_drift: hand-built wiring mutates def/written IN PLACE on the tree-resident free Varnode (bypassing setDef's erase-reinsert) so the live comparison key no longer matches the stored position (observable as the written entry still iterating inside the free section behind the pad Varnode in the definition tree); opUnsetOutput->makeFree must erase this exact object and restore the pre-drift order
destroy_after_transitions: write->opUnsetOutput(free window: insert cleared)->opSetOutput rebind->opDestroy->destroyVarnode->VarnodeBank::destroy removes the Varnode from both trees entirely
rebind_same_output_noop: opSetOutput with the Varnode that is already the op's output is the early return; no makeFree, no setDef, identical trees

observation_schema.format: Five fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus four case records
observation_schema.state: free/insert/input/written flags, defining SeqNum order, per-Varnode membership counts in each tree per stage
observation_schema.graph: complete location-tree and definition-tree iteration orders with name, space, hex offset, size, class letter, and createIndex (definition tree adds the SeqNum order or dash)

build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of Funcdata's public beginLoc/endLoc/beginDef/endDef projections plus #define private public access to PcodeOp::setOutput and Varnode::setDef for the hand-built in-place wiring in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/varnode.rs and src/coreaction.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME

coverage.opsetoutput_swap_key_lifecycle: MATCH: two full opSetOutput rebinding cycles cross the free/written key class twice; both tree iteration orders, membership counts (exactly one entry per tree per stage), insert flag, and the defining SeqNum order (back to the original op after the round trip) byte-match
coverage.makefree_under_inplace_key_drift: MATCH: after the in-place def/written mutation the definition tree iterates the written entry inside the free section (stored position), and opUnsetOutput->makeFree erases this exact object and restores the pre-drift orders; Rugra's identity erase (live-key take with Arc verification, identity-scan fallback) reproduces the stored-iterator semantics; A/B with the previous key-recomputed remove panics at this case
coverage.stale_def_tree_position_observation: MATCH: neither implementation re-sorts on in-place mutation; the pad Varnode keeps the drifted entry observable behind it in the free section
coverage.destroy_after_transition_cycle: MATCH: the free window clears insert, the rebind rewrites written, and opDestroy->destroyVarnode->VarnodeBank::destroy removes the Varnode from both trees (membership 0,0; final lists contain only the constant)
coverage.rebind_same_output_noop: MATCH: opSetOutput early-returns when the requested output is already bound; trees, membership, and def order are unchanged
coverage.setinput_transition_fresh_input: MATCH: the input-class member (create_index 2) is produced through VarnodeBank::setInput's erase-reinsert and iterates in the input class ahead of written and free in the definition tree
coverage.foreign_handle_ownership_guard: NO_ORACLE: Rugra's make_free/set_input/set_def return an Err for a foreign Arc that is not physically in the trees; Ghidra has no counterpart check (erase of a garbage iterator is undefined), so no oracle observation exists; the guard is RUGRA-GLUE
coverage.cast_output_union_resolution_closure: UNTESTED: ActionSetCasts::castOutput's union resolution (needsResolution/resolveInFlow/findResolve/setUnionField) remains a documented deferred subset (coreaction.rs cast_output Simplified note); this fixture proves the opSetOutput/opUnsetOutput/makeFree bank-key closure that the E2E panic lived in, not the full castOutput decision logic
coverage.makefree_on_input_class_varnode: UNTESTED: no case drives makeFree on an input-class Varnode (the castOutput closure never rebinds function inputs); makeFree's input-flag clearing is source-verified (varnode.cc:1323) and mirrored but not fixture-observed
